sentence: A blocked account on day one can mean hunting for the right record and owner.
Let's see an example, and hear how the Relay guide helps.
In seconds, Relay found the case, named its owner, and opened the reply field.
Maya types the details, and Relay prepares the reply and waits.
One click, and the reply is on the case.
A laptop that won't charge becomes a complete IT request, confirmed the same way.
Every action runs through one contract: the signed-in employee, an explicit confirmation, a retry-safe key, an audit trail, and a verified result.
Measured on the real app, 103 of 110 conversations ended fully right, and 39 of 42 never-seen requests passed.
Red-team attacks caused no unsafe actions, and a release gate fails the build if any of this slips.
